topic: Source-bound portfolio convergence, JADE readiness and recursive CONTROL

clusters.title: N6 workflow history and temporal control

tasks.title: Capture the starting intent and source identities
tasks.intent: Record one source head per repository, open-PR path ownership, scope, evidence classes and starting DOV/DOD before selecting a repair.
dov: Read repository instructions and current source heads once per pulse.
Record observed time, branch, source URL, owner and comparison cohort; identify intervening updates.
dod: A source-bound intake receipt identifies all included and missing repositories.
No historical observation is promoted to current-head proof.

tasks.title: Reconcile the Hub source-owner frontier
tasks.intent: Read the existing FPC controller repair and alkane landing evidence; route current source defects to their existing owner branches.
dov: Read the current #1139 head, diff, native jobs and review findings.
Verify the separate #1134 landing and post-merge evidence without assuming its former PR state persists.
dod: The current first-red source and required native proof are identified.
No second FPC evaluator, RED waiver or parallel modification of an owned controller path.

tasks.title: Repair and qualify ABACUS runtime failures
tasks.intent: Use the existing DOW repair lane and authenticated logs to distinguish formatting debt, scanner runtime failure and actual security findings.
dov: Bind each first red to repository, head, workflow, run, attempt, job and step.
Run the source-owned formatting and scanner command over the comparable population; retain scanner output.
dod: The repaired process executes and fails truthfully when the failure canary is supplied.
Security scanning remains enabled; a runtime repair does not clear unreviewed findings.

tasks.title: Resolve ABACUS source and confidentiality evidence
tasks.intent: Reconcile the existing handover with the authoritative RFI source and native A10/security evidence without exporting restricted source content.
dov: Verify each source reference and exact candidate SHA with the existing owner.
Record missing native or source evidence as missing; keep raw restricted content out of public projections.
dod: RFI source binding and confidentiality have separate evidence-backed dispositions.
A handover edit or thread reply never substitutes for native A10 or security acceptance.

tasks.title: Verify CODEX required PR contexts and aged runs
tasks.intent: Match actual required PR-context names to the candidate head and classify queued runs by identity and current relevance.
dov: Read effective required contexts, candidate SHA and check-run identities.
Recheck each aged run before proposing cancellation; distinguish obsolete, live and already-terminal runs.
dod: A context matrix shows PASS, FAIL, PENDING or UNKNOWN on the exact PR head.
Main-branch success and stale queue counts are not reused as current PR admission proof.

tasks.title: Complete the dedicated workflow-history census
tasks.intent: Collect a bounded, paginated workflow-history cohort through the existing metric owners and retain historical failure identities.
dov: Record complete pagination, time window, workflow identity, source SHA, runs, attempts and denominator.
Separate cancelled/skipped records, genuine queue wait and executed runtime; retain a digest-bound cache receipt.
dod: N6 telemetry is reproducible for its declared cohort.
Incomplete history remains PARTIAL or UNKNOWN and does not establish a new qualification.

tasks.title: Build the user-facing cluster and readiness projection
tasks.intent: Join existing JADE, issue-rank and Kahn outputs into a navigable read-only view with source dates, explicit missing evidence and deep source links.
dov: Prove canonical module reuse, private projection and source-digest parity.
Exercise negative inputs, source-age display, cluster overlap and browser interaction at desktop and narrow widths.
dod: The user can drill from core cluster to repository, task, source and DOV/DOD.
The view creates no second ledger, scheduler, metric definition or release authority.

tasks.title: Reconcile the existing GEMINI broker stack
tasks.intent: Map GEMINI/Drive ingress and the Hub GM-I-C owner stack into the same topic graph while preserving their independent IC3 conditions.
dov: Read #1135 and stacked #1152 at their current heads; verify the parent relationship.
Bind actual hosted ingress and package-content receipts separately.
dod: The bridge is represented as an independently gated source lane.
Transport success never grants content, engineering or release acceptance.

tasks.title: Map canonical binary and HTML products to source owners
tasks.intent: Record source configuration, generator, native QA, artifact digest and outward version using the existing binary-engine registry.
dov: Check declared artifact type against its canonical engine and K-series QA contract.
Follow source-to-generator-to-artifact references; keep private engineering evidence in its owner boundary.
dod: Every selected outward product has a visible missing-proof list and owner route.
Generated HTML/PDF/PPTX/XLSX is a source-bound view, never a replacement SSOT.

tasks.title: Collect exact-head native proof across the selected slice
tasks.intent: Join the lane receipts only after each repository's source correction has its own terminal native verification.
dov: Require exact repo/head/workflow/run/attempt/job/artifact identity and the actual required context set.
Run meaningful negative tests and document test/coverage populations; missing or skipped is not PASS.
dod: Every selected source lane has PASS for all required exact-head native proof before this join can complete.
A held lane or missing, failed or skipped required proof keeps this join HOLD even when the evidence inventory is complete.
One repository's success cannot compensate for another repository's missing proof.

tasks.title: Obtain eligible independent review
tasks.intent: Bind review to each final candidate SHA and separate advisory bot/test review from the eligible owner-required reviewer.
dov: Verify reviewer eligibility, review state, latest push and dismissal/staleness policy.
Requalify review after any source-head advance.
dod: Required independent review is evidenced for every candidate.
Unresolved findings and stale review retain admission HOLD.

tasks.title: Verify effective admission and rejected RED behavior
tasks.intent: Read active protection and trusted-publisher requirements, then consume an independently permitted negative-canary receipt from the canonical owner.
dov: Verify applicable rule scope, required contexts, bypass configuration and the exact rejected RED receipt.
Keep controller-bootstrap and separate non-controller canary evidence distinct.
dod: Effective rejection and successful-admission predicates are separately evidenced.
This preview performs no merge attempt, rule mutation or policy waiver.

tasks.title: Record the owner's merge and point-release decision
tasks.intent: Present concrete qualified candidates and release assets to the appropriate repository owner after all preceding gates.
dov: Confirm owner intent, final candidate SHA, source tag/version, assets, publication target and rollback plan.
Record acceptance, denial or deferral explicitly; separately read back any actual owner-performed merge/release and bind it to the admitted candidate and resulting source identity.
dod: Owner decision is explicit and source bound; recording denial or deferral does not qualify downstream CONTROL.
CONTROL remains HOLD until both an accepted owner action and read-back evidence of its actual merge/release are independently verified.
J4 candidate readiness remains distinct from J5 released and from downstream engineering acceptance.

tasks.title: Observe comparable post-merge CONTROL
tasks.intent: Use the existing pulse owner to compare admitted source, native execution and recovery behavior over repeated matched observations.
dov: Require an accepted owner action and read-back evidence of its actual merge/release as separate predicates, bound to the admitted candidate and resulting source identity.
Verify source, cohort, instrument version, denominator and observation independence before calculating deltas.
Preserve negative evidence and separate proof acquisition, actual closure, scope growth and regression.
dod: Denial, deferral or acceptance without actual merge/release read-back keeps CONTROL HOLD.
Repeated qualifying observations satisfy the owner-approved CONTROL criterion.
Scaling remains held while recurrence, missing evidence or unmatched populations persist.

tasks.title: Prepare the next-wave statistical design
tasks.intent: Specify observation units, source population, features and actual pairwise outcomes before invoking the canonical gg_MATH provider.
dov: Qualify geometry, missingness, comparability, independent units and provider SHA/digests.
For PCA compare aligned components/subspaces; for BT check identifiable connected comparisons and finite-fit conditions.
dod: The method is either provider-eligible or held with an explicit reason.
PCA loadings, model-derived strengths and reversed labels never become observed BT outcomes.

tasks.title: Carry evidence and learning into N+1 and N+2
tasks.intent: Preserve the original intent, old and new edges, predictions, actual results and blocked descendants when proposing the next bounded slice.
dov: Score prior predictions against subsequent outcomes without rewriting history.
Retain task/root identity, predecessor receipt, source SHA and supersession reason; rediscover current open and closed PRs.
dod: The next slice has a concrete source-owned TODO, DOV/DOD and path-disjoint matrix.
No-value or owner-blocked work is parked; expansion follows evidence and capacity rather than raw worker count.
